description_en: Retrieves the metadata of a share link without authentication
name: GetShareLinkByAnonymous

access_count.description_en: The total number of times the share link has been accessed

avatar.description_en: The URL of the creator's avatar

creator_id.description_en: The ID of the share's creator

creator_name.description_en: The desensitized name of the share's creator

creator_phone.description_en: The desensitized phone number of the share's creator

disable_download.description_en: Specifies whether downloading is disabled. If `true`, the shared content cannot be downloaded

disable_preview.description_en: Specifies whether previews are disabled. If `true`, the shared content cannot be previewed

disable_save.description_en: Specifies whether saving is disabled. If `true`, the shared content cannot be saved

download_count.description_en: The total number of times the shared content has been downloaded

download_limit.description_en: The maximum number of downloads allowed for the shared content

expiration.description_en: The expiration time of the share link, specified in UTC and formatted according to RFC 3339

has_pwd.description_en: Specifies whether the share is protected by an access code
has_pwd.description_zh: 分享是否设置了提取码

preview_count.description_en: The total number of times the shared content has been previewed

preview_limit.description_en: The maximum number of previews allowed for the shared content

report_count.description_en: The total number of times the share has been reported

save_count.description_en: The total number of times the shared content has been saved

save_download_limit.description_en: The maximum total number of saves and downloads allowed for the shared content
save_download_limit.description_zh: 转存和下载总次数限制

save_limit.description_en: The maximum number of saves allowed for the shared content

updated_at.description_en: The time when the share link was last modified, specified in UTC and formatted according to RFC 3339

video_preview_count.description_en: The total number of times a video in the share has been previewed

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. For more information, see the following parameters
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body. For more information, see the following parameters
v1_parameters.name: body
